verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents data-privacy controls like MIP opt-out (no retention when opted out) and EU/AU/India regional endpoints for data residency, which speak to configurable retention/data handling, but there is no mention of per-call recording toggles, call-recording consent/disclosure workflows, or telephony-specific recording controls. missing for 10: per-call recording enable/disable controls, consent/disclosure messaging features, explicit retention duration settings tied to individual calls, and any compliance certification (e.g., call-recording law compliance) documentation.
